policy: Every case requires current-candidate Chrome evidence. Automated suites are partial coverage, not a full-feature pass.

cases.title: Repeated toolbar launches
cases.procedure: Click the extension 20 times, including rapid clicks.
cases.expected: Exactly one editor workspace; no blank New Tab window.
cases.regression: Duplicate PostCard Editor / New Tab windows reported September 11.

cases.title: Preserve open draft and Slides
cases.procedure: Edit text without leaving; reopen via toolbar, then repeat while in Slides.
cases.expected: Focus existing workspace without reload, lost edits, or extra window.

cases.title: Worker restart and minimized window
cases.procedure: Minimize editor; stop extension service worker in DevTools; click toolbar.
cases.expected: Existing window is restored and focused; no duplicate.

cases.title: Close and reopen; failed launch
cases.procedure: Close editor and reopen; use mocked query/create failures.
cases.expected: One replacement after closing; failures do not multiply windows; retry succeeds.

cases.title: Settings reuse
cases.procedure: Open Settings repeatedly while editor stays open.
cases.expected: One Settings window, separate from one editor.

cases.title: Recorder return
cases.procedure: Go Editor → Recorder → Back to editor ten times; test a failed editor open.
cases.expected: At most one editor and one recorder; no blank windows; recorder stays open on failed return.
cases.regression: Duplicate recorder tabs and focus handoff were fixed in v0.8.3–v0.8.7.

cases.title: Social source survives Slides
cases.procedure: Launch from a composer, enter Slides, edit and return, then insert a card.
cases.expected: Insertion targets the originating browser window; navigation preserves source IDs.
cases.regression: Source tab/window parameters were discarded during editor/Slides navigation.

cases.title: Context menu selection
cases.procedure: Right-click selected page text with editor closed, then already open.
cases.expected: Selection can be used to create a card without duplicate windows or silently losing a draft.

cases.title: Create and edit
cases.procedure: Add two text blocks; double-click and type multiline text.
cases.expected: Both blocks stay independently editable; caret and selection work.

cases.title: Drag and deselect
cases.procedure: Select/drag text, click empty canvas, then drag again.
cases.expected: Text moves; blank-canvas click clears selection; editing does not unexpectedly drag.
cases.regression: Text movement and clicking-away deselection regressions.

cases.title: Resize and orientation
cases.procedure: Resize at 0°, 45°, 90°, 180°, 270°; use dial, numeric entry and snapping.
cases.expected: Orientation controls exist; common angles snap; resize follows the rotated axes.
cases.regression: Rotation dial vanished; rotated resize broke.

cases.title: Text formatting
cases.procedure: Change font, size, color, bold, italic, alignment, width, line height and shadow.
cases.expected: Canvas and exported image agree for each selected block.

cases.title: Multilingual fonts and emoji
cases.procedure: Enter Bangla, Arabic, Japanese, Chinese and emoji; change Google Font; export PNG.
cases.expected: Text remains legible and matches the editor; missing fonts report/fall back sensibly.

cases.title: Image clipboard and file import
cases.procedure: Paste a screenshot; insert an image file; add a second image.
cases.expected: Each image appears as an independently selectable object.
cases.regression: Missing image copy/paste support.

cases.title: Image movement and resize
cases.procedure: Drag and resize images from all four corners in every card format.
cases.expected: Aspect ratio and opposite anchor remain correct; other objects do not move.

cases.title: Layer ordering
cases.procedure: Overlap text, image and table; move each forward/back and select covered objects.
cases.expected: All types share the same order in editor and export; text remains reachable.
cases.regression: Pasted image blocked text; foreground/background controls missing.

cases.title: Copy, cut, paste and duplicate
cases.procedure: Copy/cut/paste/duplicate each object type; use keyboard and available buttons.
cases.expected: Independent copies with unique IDs; native text selection clipboard still works.

cases.title: Delete selection
cases.procedure: Delete text/image/table using trash, Delete, Backspace and cut; type Backspace inside text.
cases.expected: Only selected object is removed; editing Backspace deletes characters.
cases.regression: Deletion controls and text selection regressions.

cases.title: Undo and redo
cases.procedure: Add, move, resize, rotate, reorder, delete, then undo and redo repeatedly.
cases.expected: Content, geometry and layer order restore without mutating neighboring slides.

cases.title: Table editing and formatting
cases.procedure: Add a table; edit cells; change template/header/font/borders/colors; drag and resize.
cases.expected: Cells stay editable and all styles/geometry survive export and reopen.

cases.title: Solid and gradients
cases.procedure: Use solid, preset and custom gradients; switch formats; reopen.
cases.expected: Background renders consistently on canvas, PNG and Slides.

cases.title: Image framing
cases.procedure: Upload a background; test Cover/Contain/Actual, darkness and panning.
cases.expected: Framing is preserved in editor, exported card and Slides.

cases.title: Giphy and Featured
cases.procedure: Search and select Giphy/Featured media; simulate network failure.
cases.expected: Results apply correctly; failures show useful errors without breaking the editor.

cases.title: Animated GIF background and object
cases.procedure: Use a GIF with visibly different frames as background and as an image object.
cases.expected: Video contains multiple frames, correct loop timing and ordered overlays.
cases.regression: GIF export froze on first frame.

cases.title: Add and edit blank slide
cases.procedure: Create two slides; use +; Edit slide; add text; Back to Slides; reopen.
cases.expected: The new slide is editable and its edits persist; neighbors remain unchanged.
cases.regression: New slides could not be edited; Back to Slides disappeared.

cases.title: Duplicate, reorder and delete
cases.procedure: Duplicate a slide, move it, delete another, then edit the duplicate.
cases.expected: Stable slide IDs target the intended slide; remaining content stays intact.
cases.regression: Slides overwrote the wrong slide.

cases.title: Thumbnail navigation
cases.procedure: Use thumbnails, previous/next, drag reorder, Earlier/Later and preview.
cases.expected: Selection, index, preview, thumbnail and editor agree.

cases.title: Duration persistence
cases.procedure: Set distinct durations including 120 seconds; edit via both navigation routes.
cases.expected: Durations never reset to 3 seconds and totals stay correct.
cases.regression: Long slide/music clipped to 3 seconds.

cases.title: Narration per slide
cases.procedure: Record narration on two slides; play/pause/delete one recording; edit and reorder slides.
cases.expected: Narration stays associated with the correct slide and voice levels persist.
cases.regression: Per-slide recording controls disappeared; metadata must survive editing.

cases.title: Music across slideshow
cases.procedure: Add MP3; play/pause/stop/remove; set voice and music volumes separately.
cases.expected: One music track spans slides and both volume controls affect export.
cases.regression: Slideshow music and volume controls disappeared.

cases.title: Full music duration
cases.procedure: Use one 3-second slide and a longer music track; export with option off and on.
cases.expected: Off uses configured duration; on includes full track by extending last slide; narration preserved.
cases.regression: Long music was truncated; full-length option required.

cases.title: Ten-minute limit
cases.procedure: Set duration to just below, at and above 600 seconds; add/reorder slides.
cases.expected: Limit is applied consistently; no Free/Pro gate or hardcoded activation key.

cases.title: Reload and slow/failed storage
cases.procedure: Save/reopen deck; throttle/fail storage in test harness; return immediately after editing.
cases.expected: Save completes before navigation; failures keep editor open and never save empty startup state.

cases.title: PNG fidelity
cases.procedure: Export all three formats with rotated text, image, table and background.
cases.expected: Dimensions, colors, fonts, geometry and stacking match the visible card.

cases.title: Animated card MP4
cases.procedure: Apply text entrance and background pan/zoom; export with chosen duration.
cases.expected: Actual playable MP4 contains motion and matches requested duration.
cases.regression: Animated card MP4 support disappeared.

cases.title: Slideshow MP4
cases.procedure: Export multiple slides with GIF, text motion, narration and music.
cases.expected: Real MP4 plays with correct order, timing, dimensions, audio and transitions.
cases.regression: Slideshow video export and audio features disappeared.

cases.title: Export progress and long audio
cases.procedure: Export a long one-slide audio video; observe modal, percentage, completion and failure.
cases.expected: Progress remains visible and responsive; completion occurs only after output is ready.
cases.regression: Progress dialog disappeared; long audio progress appeared stalled.

cases.title: Origin-clean and encoder errors
cases.procedure: Use remote GIF/image; simulate fetch failure and unavailable MP4 encoder.
cases.expected: No captureStream tainted-canvas crash; errors are visible; WebM never mislabeled as MP4.
cases.regression: captureStream origin-clean failures; export duration/format mismatches.

cases.title: Camera and microphone devices
cases.procedure: Start/stop camera; choose camera/mic; deny permission; remove device; close recorder.
cases.expected: Useful errors; selections persist; all media tracks stop when stopped/closed.

cases.title: Record, stop, retake and download
cases.procedure: Record voice and overlay; stop, play, retake and download.
cases.expected: Playable file includes intended microphone audio; repeated cycles remain usable.

cases.title: Framing and mirror
cases.procedure: Verify default Cover; test Contain/Actual, zoom 1–3×, wheel zoom, pan, mirror and reset.
cases.expected: Framing is correct in preview and recorded output; reset works.
cases.regression: Cover default and framing helpers were restored previously.

cases.title: Overlay text and independent drag
cases.procedure: Change overlay/font size/color; drag text; pan camera elsewhere.
cases.expected: Text hit target wins; video pan does not steal text drag; recording includes overlay.
cases.regression: Overlay text dragging repeatedly broke.

cases.title: Background None/Blur/Color/Image
cases.procedure: Try all modes while moving head/shoulders and wearing headphones; record each.
cases.expected: Person stays sharp; no major halo, skin bleed, beard artifact or heavy ghost trail.
cases.regression: Segmentation mask, halo, color-bleed and jaw artifacts were repaired in v0.8.x.

cases.title: Bundled model and WASM startup
cases.procedure: Load unpacked with network offline for model assets; start all background modes.
cases.expected: Local model/WASM assets load under MV3 CSP; no missing helper crash.
cases.regression: MediaPipe loading, missing stopSegmentationProcessor/currentVideoRect regressions.

cases.title: X/Twitter composer
cases.procedure: Use a disposable draft on X/Twitter; insert PNG and caption; verify video where offered; do not publish.
cases.expected: Correct supported composer receives media/caption; unsupported state has clear error; source draft remains intact.

cases.title: Facebook composer
cases.procedure: Use a disposable draft on Facebook; insert PNG and caption; verify video where offered; do not publish.
cases.expected: Correct supported composer receives media/caption; unsupported state has clear error; source draft remains intact.

cases.title: Instagram composer
cases.procedure: Use a disposable draft on Instagram; insert PNG and caption; verify video where offered; do not publish.
cases.expected: Correct supported composer receives media/caption; unsupported state has clear error; source draft remains intact.

cases.title: LinkedIn composer
cases.procedure: Use a disposable draft on LinkedIn; insert PNG and caption; verify video where offered; do not publish.
cases.expected: Correct supported composer receives media/caption; unsupported state has clear error; source draft remains intact.

cases.title: Reddit composer
cases.procedure: Use a disposable draft on Reddit; insert PNG and caption; verify video where offered; do not publish.
cases.expected: Correct supported composer receives media/caption; unsupported state has clear error; source draft remains intact.

cases.title: Bluesky composer
cases.procedure: Use a disposable draft on Bluesky; insert PNG and caption; verify video where offered; do not publish.
cases.expected: Correct supported composer receives media/caption; unsupported state has clear error; source draft remains intact.

cases.title: Provider, model and key settings
cases.procedure: Switch OpenAI/Anthropic, preset/custom model; save and reopen; show/hide key.
cases.expected: Settings persist and selected model is used; key is not exposed in logs.

cases.title: AI generation and errors
cases.procedure: Use mocked provider responses and errors for Test AI.
cases.expected: JSON is parsed; card/caption lengths handled; errors are readable; no post is submitted.

cases.title: Scheduling and deduplication
cases.procedure: Use a fake clock with recurring/one-time schedules, days, AM/PM and disabled state.
cases.expected: Correct local-time execution once per scheduled slot; one-time disables after run.

cases.title: Run/post and history
cases.procedure: Use a mocked social adapter to run success/failure, retry and history clear.
cases.expected: History accurately reports outcomes; no real post or paid API call without explicit authorization.

cases.title: Restart and upgrade existing state
cases.procedure: Load a pre-change saved deck with images, tables, rotation and audio; close/reopen Chrome.
cases.expected: Existing project survives with all content/settings and unique object/slide IDs.

cases.title: Layout and button spacing
cases.procedure: Inspect editor, Slides, recorder and dialogs at normal size, smaller window and 200% zoom.
cases.expected: Controls remain visible, usable and separated; no touching export buttons.
cases.regression: Export dialog buttons touched; controls repeatedly disappeared.

cases.title: Keyboard and focus
cases.procedure: Use Tab, Enter, Escape, copy/paste, Delete and rotation arrow keys across dialogs/editor.
cases.expected: Focus and shortcuts operate the intended control without accidental deletion.

cases.title: Version consistency
cases.procedure: Compare manifest, popup, editor footer, credits and Settings; compare with published store version.
cases.expected: All labels match candidate version, which is greater than store version.
cases.regression: Manifest was lower than published 0.9.9; UI version labels were stale.

cases.title: Feature baseline and complete assets
cases.procedure: Review diff against previous delivered feature baseline; inspect script references and local assets.
cases.expected: No recovered feature or bundled asset disappears; do not start from stale main.
cases.regression: Older main branch erased rotation, motion and audio features.

cases.title: Privacy and permissions
cases.procedure: Inspect manifest/Privacy link and key storage; review any permission changes.
cases.expected: Policy link works; declared data handling matches behavior; no unexplained permission expansion.

cases.title: Exact release package smoke
cases.procedure: Install final ZIP unpacked in a disposable Chrome profile; repeat window/slide/export smoke.
cases.expected: Correct version loads with no extension errors; record exact ZIP SHA-256 and source fingerprint.

cases.title: Historical promise audit
cases.procedure: Compare README feature history with UI: especially old JPG/WebP downloads and each social adapter.
cases.expected: Any missing previously promised capability is recorded as a defect or explicitly retired, never silently dropped.
